description: A dark wood armchair with a black cushioned seat. The chair has a simple, modern design with clean lines. The armrests are integrated into the frame, creating a continuous loop from the backrest to the front legs. The backrest consists of three vertical wooden slats. The seat appears to be upholstered in a dark material, possibly leather or faux leather. The wood shows signs of wear, with some lighter patches and scuff marks, suggesting it might be vintage or have a distressed finish. The overall appearance is minimalist and functional.
